ideas.title: Impatient
ideas.action: stands up on its hind legs, crosses its front legs, taps one foot impatiently and looks at its wrist like checking a watch
ideas.caption: You're late ⌚

ideas.title: Gasps and runs
ideas.action: stands up on its hind legs, sees the camera, gasps with its mouth wide open and runs away on two legs like a human
ideas.caption: Caught in 4K 😱
